### Loading Relevant Packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)   ## for data cleaning
library(ggplot2)     ## to make nice plots
library(glmmTMB)     ## to fit complex mixed effects models
library(lme4)        ## to fit linear and mixed effects models
```

### Loading Data

```{r}
## to convert NAs into zeros in data table
soil <- read_csv("data/processed/soil.csv") %>%    ## reads in csv file
  mutate(total = replace_na(total, 0),             ## changes "total" variable
         n_class = replace_na(n_class, 0))         ## changes "n_class" variable

## to view first couple rows of data
head(soil)
```

### Exploratory Data Analysis

**Guiding Questions**:

*Ground Cover and Soil Arthropods*

- Does ground cover vary across garden sites?

- Does the average ground cover affect soil arthropod diversity across garden sites?

- Does the average ground cover affect soil health properties across garden sites?

*Ground Cover and Soil Health*

- Does the average ground cover affect soil inorganic nitrogen content across garden sites?

- Does the average ground cover affect the activity of the CBH enzyme across garden sites?

*Micro-habitat and Soil Arthropods*

- Do the number of different class types (n_class) vary by micro-habitat (garden bed vs pathway) across garden sites?

- Does arthropod abundance (total number of soil arthropods) vary across micro-habitat types?

#### Ground Cover and Soil Arthropods

*Does ground cover vary across garden sites?*

```{r}
## percent mulch cover across garden sites
ggplot(soil, aes(x = site, y = mulch)) +
  geom_col()

## percent bare soil cover across garden sites
ggplot(soil, aes(x = site, y = bare)) +
  geom_col()

## percent litter cover across garden sites
ggplot(soil, aes(x = site, y = litter)) +
  geom_col()

## herbaceous cover across sites
ggplot(soil, aes(x = site, y = herbaceous)) +
  geom_col()

```

*Does average ground cover affect soil arthropod richness?*

```{r}
## new data table with average soil cover and soil arthropods richness/abundance values
cover_aps <- soil %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_bare = mean (bare, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_herbaceous = mean (bare, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_litter = mean (litter, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_mulch = mean (mulch, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_class = mean (n_class, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_total = mean (total, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

## average mulch and aps richness
ggplot(cover_aps, aes(x = mean_mulch, y = mean_class)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = site, vjust = -0.8)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE)

## average mulch and aps abundance
ggplot(cover_aps, aes(x = mean_mulch, y = mean_total)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE)

## average bare soil and aps richness
ggplot(cover_aps, aes(x = mean_bare, y = mean_class)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE)

## average bare soil and aps abundance
ggplot(cover_aps, aes(x = mean_bare, y = mean_total)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE)

## average litter and aps richness
ggplot(cover_aps, aes(x = mean_litter, y = mean_class)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE)

## average litter and aps abundance
ggplot(cover_aps, aes(x = mean_litter, y = mean_total)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE)

```

#### Ground Cover and Soil Health

*Does the average percent **mulch** cover affect soil inorganic nitrogen content across garden sites?*

```{r}
## new data table with averaged variables of interest
cover_soil <- soil %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_bare = mean (bare, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_herbaceous = mean (bare, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_litter = mean (litter, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_mulch = mean (mulch, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_no3 = mean (no3_ug_g, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_nh4 = mean (nh4_ug_g, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_cbh = mean (cbh_mmol_g_h, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

## exploratory visualizations

## average mulch and inorganic N content
ggplot(cover_soil, aes(x = mean_mulch, y = mean_nh4)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE)

ggplot(cover_soil, aes(x = mean_mulch, y = mean_no3)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE)

## average bare soil and inorganic N content
ggplot(cover_soil, aes(x = mean_bare, y = mean_nh4)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE)

ggplot(cover_soil, aes(x = mean_bare, y = mean_no3)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE)

## average litter and inorganic N content
ggplot(cover_soil, aes(x = mean_litter, y = mean_nh4)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE)

ggplot(cover_soil, aes(x = mean_litter, y = mean_no3)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE)
```

*Does the average percent **mulch** cover affect the activity of the CBH enzyme across garden sites?*

```{r}
## average mulch and CBH enzyme
ggplot(cover_soil, aes(x = mean_mulch, y = mean_cbh)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE)

## average bare soil and CBH enzyme
ggplot(cover_soil, aes(x = mean_bare, y = mean_cbh)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE)

## average litter and CBH enzyme
ggplot(cover_soil, aes(x = mean_litter, y = mean_cbh)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE)

## average herbaceous and CBH enzyme
ggplot(cover_soil, aes(x = mean_herbaceous, y = mean_cbh)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE)
```

#### Micro-habitat and Soil Arthropods

*Do the number of different class types (n_class) vary by micro-habitat (garden bed vs pathway) across garden sites?*

```{r}
## bar graph: aps richness across garden sites
ggplot(soil, aes(x = site, y = n_class, fill = microhabitat)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge")

# aps richness and microhabitat by site
ggplot(soil, aes(x = microhabitat, y = n_class, fill = microhabitat)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~site)
  
```

*Does arthropod abundance (total number of soil arthropods) vary across micro-habitat types?*

```{r}
ggplot(soil, aes(x = site, y = total, fill = microhabitat)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge")
```

#### Micro-habitat and Soil Health

*Does soil inorganic nitrogen content (NH4 and NO3) vary by micro-habitat?*

```{r}
## ammonium (NH4) content 
ggplot(soil, aes(x = site, y = nh4_ug_g, color = microhabitat)) +
  geom_boxplot()

## nitrate (NO3) content
ggplot(soil, aes(x = site, y = no3_ug_g, color = microhabitat)) +
  geom_boxplot()

## checking distribution
hist(soil$nh4_ug_g)   ## right skewed
hist(soil$no3_ug_g)   ## right skewed

```
